description: Close the session started with start_agent_session. Save its outcome, decisions, blockers and validation results for the next agent to review.

blockers.description: Unresolved obstacles encountered during the session.

codeChanges.description: Required completion declaration. Submit every code file changed during this session with its actual unified diff. Use [] only when no code changed. Do not include secrets or unrelated pre-existing edits.

decisions.description: Decisions made during this session to preserve for the next handoff.

expectedVersion.description: Current version of the target record from its latest read or mutation result. A stale value causes a version conflict; re-read before retrying.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated retry key. Reuse the same key and identical payload only to retry the same mutation; use a new key for a new action.

outcome.description: Result of the agent session being closed.

projectId.description: Owned project ID returned by list_linked_projects or map_project; do not use a local path or repository URL.

sessionId.description: Active session record.id from start_agent_session for this project. Pass it on later project calls after starting the session.

summary.description: Concise account of the work or result being recorded.

validations.description: Checks performed during the session and their results.

name: finish_agent_session
title: Finish agent session
